title: The AI That Might Build Itself
description:
Anthropic told investors in an amended S one filing that its future models may imminently meet its own definition of dramatically accelerated, A I driven progress, while saying no current model has crossed the line. We also cover new Claude Code limits, malware that asks an A I to rank its victims, hundreds of apps hiding abusive deepfake tools, Goldman Sachs pulling coding tools from most staff, and the Meituan LongCat two point five launch.

As always, we label what is confirmed, preliminary, reported or unverified, so you know exactly how far to trust each story.
